reports.title: Reports
reports.viewerHint: Viewer role — sign in as a Designer to create reports.
reports.name: Name
reports.emptyHint: Start from a blank report or a sample above.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Reports exported without waiting — status updates automatically.
jobs.notificationsBlocked: Notifications blocked — use the padlock icon in the address bar to allow them.
jobs.notificationsBlockedHelp: Your browser is blocking notifications for this site. Open the padlock (or site info) icon in the address bar and set Notifications to Allow, then reload.
jobs.emptyHint: Open a report's ⋮ menu (or right-click it) in Reports and choose "Run in background".
jobs.noMatchHint: Pick another status, or go back to All.
jobs.retention: Finished jobs are removed automatically after 30 days.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Desktop applications and services call your reports with these keys. A key can list and run reports only — it cannot change anything.
apiKeys.disableHint: Stop this key from working, without deleting it
apiKeys.emptyHint: Create a key for each application that needs to run reports, so you can switch off one without affecting the others.
apiKeys.footnote: Only the first characters of a key are kept for identification. The full key is shown once, when it is created.

expiry.pickDate: Pick the last day the key works
expiry.neverHint: The key works until you disable or delete it.

reveal.title: Your new key
reveal.warning: Copy this key now. For security it will not be shown again — if you lose it, create a new one.

reportCode.label: Report code
reportCode.hint: Applications call the report by this name. Letters a-z, digits, - and _ only. It stays the same if you rename the report.
reportCode.invalid: Only a-z, 0-9, - and _ are allowed (no spaces or accented letters).

history.title: Version history — {{name}}
history.previewTitle: Rendered preview of the selected version
history.restore: Use v{{version}} as the new version
history.alreadyCurrent: This is the version in use.
history.confirm: v{{version}} will be saved again as v{{next}}. The current version (v{{current}}) stays in the history, so you can come back to it at any time.
history.unsavedWarning: Unsaved changes in the designer will be lost.

transfer.dependencyHint: {{count}} report(s) were added automatically because a selected report embeds them as a subreport.
transfer.connectionsNote: These reports query databases through connections that must exist, with the same names, in the target environment. The package carries names only, never passwords:
transfer.redactedNote: {{count}} secret value(s) (Authorization headers, API keys, tokens in REST sources) were removed from the package. Enter them again in the target environment.
transfer.stripSample: Leave out the sample data stored inside JSON data sources
transfer.stripSampleHint: Sample rows can contain real data. Reports still work; the designer just has nothing to preview with.
transfer.overwriteNote: {{count}} existing report(s) will be overwritten. Each overwrite is saved as a new version, so you can go back to the previous one from the report's version history.
transfer.invalidNote: Reports marked invalid are skipped; the rest can still be imported.

export.title: Export as package
export.done: The package was downloaded. Import it from the Reports page of the other environment.

import.title: Import package
import.dropHint: A .jrdpkg file exported from another environment. Nothing changes until you confirm.

connection.missing: not found here — create it before running the report
connection.providerMismatch: exists, but with a different database type

warning.connectionProviderMismatch: Connection "{{name}}" exists here with a different database type.
warning.redacted: {{count}} secret value(s) were left out of the package; enter them again here.
warning.subreportUnresolved: "{{name}}" embeds a report that is not part of this import.
warning.subreportMissing: "{{name}}" embeds a subreport that no longer exists.
warning.assetMissing: An image used by "{{name}}" could not be found and was left out.

result.title: Import finished
result.undoHint: Every change is in the report's version history, so an overwrite can be rolled back there.

team.title: Team
team.ownRoleLocked: You can't change your own role
team.lockedHint: Locked after too many wrong passwords. Send a reset link to let them back in now.
team.resetLinkCopied: Reset link for {{name}} copied — it works once, for 2 hours
team.removeText: They lose access right away. Reports, schedules and jobs they created stay with the organization.
team.noMailBanner: Email isn't set up, so invitations and password resets can't be emailed — you'll get links to copy instead.
team.inviteEmailHelper: We'll email them the invitation. Leave empty to just get a link.
team.inviteNoMailHelper: Email isn't set up — you'll get a link to send yourself.
team.inviteSent: We emailed the invitation to {{email}}. You can also share this link:
team.inviteNotSent: The email to {{email}} couldn't be sent. Share this link with them instead:
team.inviteShare: Share this link with the person you're inviting. It works once.
team.inviteNoMail: Email isn't set up, so nothing was sent to {{email}}. Share this link with them:

email.title: Email
email.description: Used to send scheduled reports by email. Any standard SMTP account works — Exchange/Office 365, Gmail (with an app password), or your own mail server.
email.notConfigured: No account configured yet — fill this in and save to enable emailing scheduled reports.
email.passwordUnchanged: Unchanged — leave blank to keep it
email.testHint: Tests whatever's in the form above — no need to save first.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Open a report's ⋮ menu (or right-click it) in Reports and choose “Schedule…” to add one.
schedules.emptyHint: Open a report's ⋮ menu on the Reports page and choose “Schedule…” to send it automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your own preferences — stored in this browser, not shared with the team.

toolbar.historyHint: See earlier versions of this report and go back to one

schedule.clampHint: Clamped to the last day in shorter months.
schedule.shareEachRun: Create a share link each run
schedule.noMailAccount: No mail account is configured yet (Email tab) — emailing will silently be skipped until you set one up.
schedule.manageHint: Manage it from the Schedules tab.

newReport.title: New report
newReport.blankFreeHint: Place elements anywhere on a fixed canvas
newReport.blankBandedHint: Header / detail / footer bands that repeat per row
newReport.tuneHint: Margins and columns can be fine-tuned later from the Page panel.

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.description: Anyone with a link below can view and export this report — no sign-in required. They can't open it in the designer.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — copy the link manually.

designer.selectElement: Select an element to edit its properties.
designer.multiSelect: Edits apply to all selected elements.

roles.DesignerHint: Creates and edits reports, manages the team and settings.
roles.ViewerHint: Opens, runs and exports reports. Cannot change anything.

err.wrongPassword: Wrong password. Try again or click Forgot password to reset it.
err.passwordRules: Your password doesn't meet all the requirements below
err.passwordMismatch: Those passwords didn't match. Try again.
err.orgRequired: Enter a name for your organization
err.codeRequired: Enter the invite code you were given

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.step1: Enter your name and work email
signUp.emailHelper: You'll use this address to sign in.
signUp.newOrgHint: You'll be its Designer, with full access.
signUp.joinOrgHint: Your role is set by whoever invited you.

join.title: Join {{org}}
join.invalidText: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
join.summary: {{name}}, your account will be created and you'll join {{org}} as {{role}}.

forgotPage.title: Account recovery
forgotPage.subtitle: Enter the email of your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPage.sentText: If {{email}} has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 2 hours.
forgotPage.noMail: Nothing arrived? Your organization may not have email set up yet — ask a Designer on your team for a reset link.

resetPage.title: Choose a new password
resetPage.badLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
resetPage.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.

session.title: Your session has ended
session.text: For your security you've been signed out. Sign in again to continue — your open work is still here.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your name, password and how your team sees you.
account.emailFixed: Your email can't be changed here.
